scope: First implemented BU core refinement following the v2/v3 design review: Marsh, Law/Sert, near-ground finishes and core kerbs
referenceLimits: Marsh details are photo-interpreted proportions, not measured facade dimensions.
Law/Sert hierarchy uses the 2012 renovation PNF; it is not a current as-built survey.
Existing GIS footprints, source building heights, navigation colliders and DEM remain unchanged.
Paving dimensions and kerb ramp profiles are authored construction detail, not surveyed individual slabs or ramps.

changes.marsh: Stone niche around narrow dark glazing, smaller lower lights, paired metal-framed doors, flush stair nosings, round central handrail, recessed plaza-facing connecting-wing windows; roof soffit pulled back behind the niche.
changes.sert: Law solid crown and core walls, recessed window fields, distinct south/north hierarchy, Butler entrance; Mugar deep fins restricted to south/east faces; cast-concrete finish replaces false masonry joints.
changes.ground: Concrete sidewalks, stone courtyard slabs, rose-granite plaza and brick entrance paving have distinct metre-scale joints; University Road / Marsh / Sert core kerbs have terrain-following vertical faces and lowered crossings.
changes.mobile: Signed normalized Int8 normals stored with four-byte stride; backward-compatible zero-copy decoder. No position or collision quantization change.

validation.unitTests: 51 files / 263 tests passed; subsequently added 2 Int8 tests and reran the decoder file, 20/20 passed (265 total covered).
validation.build: npm run build:cloudflare passed: 95 assets, 136.79 MiB staged; not deployed in this pass.
validation.fixedViews: 6 same-camera before/after captures; no page/GLSL errors or invalid geometry vertices.
validation.mobilePlay: 29 BU destinations, touch movement, HD opt-in, save persistence, low-quality reload and viewport fit passed.
validation.mobileBudget: Touch Chromium: JS heap peak 79.36 MiB, backing storage peak 71.76 MiB; no desktop MIT/detail GLBs requested. This is not a physical iPhone test.
validation.comparisonReport: 6 image pairs, comparison slider and 390px layout passed.
